glyph_origin: Ideogram (指事) – based on the structure of 言, with an additional short horizontal stroke inside the 口 (“mouth”), forming a shape similar to 甘. The Shuowen Jiezi describes the structure as 从言含一 ("from 言 containing 一"). The added stroke graphically seals the mouth, likely representing partially closed or muffled vocalization, in contrast with 言 (“articulate speech”). This is consistent with the *ʔəm word family, which clusters around meanings of covering and closure: compare homophones 瘖 and 喑 (“mute”), and 韽 (“faint, weak sound”). See also 言.
shuowen: The Shuowen Jiezi describes the structure as 从言含一 ("from 言 containing 一").
